description: This file defines constants, macros, and inline functions for the Synopsys Designware Watchdog Timer driver in Zephyr OS. It includes register addresses, bit masks, and functions to configure and control the watchdog timer.

methods.name: dw_wdt_enable
methods.description: Enables the watchdog timer by setting the WDT_EN bit in the control register.

methods.name: dw_wdt_response_mode_set
methods.description: Sets the response mode of the watchdog (interrupt or reset).

methods.name: dw_wdt_reset_pulse_length_set
methods.description: Configures the reset pulse length in pclk cycles.

methods.name: dw_wdt_timeout_period_set
methods.description: Sets the watchdog timeout period.

methods.name: dw_wdt_timeout_period_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current timeout period range.

methods.name: dw_wdt_timeout_period_init_set
methods.description: Sets the initial timeout period after reset.

methods.name: dw_wdt_current_counter_value_register_get
methods.description: Gets the current value of the watchdog counter.

methods.name: dw_wdt_counter_restart
methods.description: Restarts the watchdog counter and clears the interrupt.

methods.name: dw_wdt_interrupt_status_register_get
methods.description: Checks if the watchdog interrupt is active.

methods.name: dw_wdt_clear_interrupt
methods.description: Clears the watchdog interrupt.

methods.name: dw_wdt_user_top_max_get
methods.description: Gets the maximum timeout period parameter.

methods.name: dw_wdt_user_top_init_max_get
methods.description: Gets the maximum initial timeout period parameter.

methods.name: dw_wdt_timeout_period_rst_get
methods.description: Gets the default timeout range after reset.

methods.name: dw_wdt_cnt_rst_get
methods.description: Gets the default timeout counter value after reset.

methods.name: dw_wdt_cnt_width_get
methods.description: Gets the width of the watchdog counter.

methods.name: dw_wdt_dflt_timeout_period_init_get
methods.description: Gets the default initial timeout period.

methods.name: dw_wdt_dflt_timeout_period_get
methods.description: Gets the default timeout period.

methods.name: dw_wdt_dflt_rpl_get
methods.description: Gets the default reset pulse length.

methods.name: dw_wdt_apb_data_width_get
methods.description: Gets the APB data bus width.

methods.name: dw_wdt_pause_get
methods.description: Checks if pause signal is enabled.

methods.name: dw_wdt_use_fix_timeout_period_get
methods.description: Checks if timeout period range is fixed.

methods.name: dw_wdt_hc_timeout_period_get
methods.description: Checks if timeout period is hardcoded.

methods.name: dw_wdt_hc_reset_pulse_length_get
methods.description: Checks if reset pulse length is hardcoded.

methods.name: dw_wdt_hc_response_mode_get
methods.description: Checks if response mode is hardcoded.

methods.name: dw_wdt_dual_timeout_period_get
methods.description: Checks if a second timeout period is supported.

methods.name: dw_wdt_dflt_response_mode_get
methods.description: Gets the default response mode after reset.

methods.name: dw_wdt_always_en_get
methods.description: Checks if watchdog is enabled from reset.

methods.name: dw_wdt_comp_version_get
methods.description: Gets the component version.

methods.name: dw_wdt_comp_type_get
methods.description: Gets the component type.
